content: GPU Gems 3 Chapter 30 describes 3D Eulerian fields, semi-Lagrangian advection, six-neighbour pressure iteration, boundary-aware projection, numerical dissipation, and front-to-back volume ray marching. It explicitly notes staggered MAC grids are more robust than its pedagogical collocated scheme. Its Direct3D 10 implementation and hardware performance numbers are historical, not Metal recommendations or forecasts. Retrieved with webfetch because the suggested jina provider is unavailable.
